title: lithocarpus wenzigianus
intro: Lithocarpus wenzigianus, commonly known as the Wenzig's Lithocarpus, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family (Fagaceae). It is native to tropical Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Lithocarpus wenzigianus include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help to protect against diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
